title: Walking Distance To Vandy & Belmont/2BR2BA/Parking
description:
This newly posted condo is a freshly renovated modern-designed 2 bedroom condo, located between Belmount University Mansions and Vanderbilt University.
Walking distance to Vanderbilt University, Belmont University, 21th Ave. S., Hillsboro Village. Minutes drive to Music Row, 12th Ave South, midtown, downtown Nashville & Broadway...
Free parking, spacious, host up to 8 people, Laundry in unit & small balcony. Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

The space
Our two bedroom condo features two queen beds and also have a queen size sofa bed plus two single beds in the living area. There are two full bathrooms for convenience. Cook breakfast and brew complimentary coffee in our full kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances. Relax in the comfy living room with a private balcony and enjoy a flat screen TV for streaming Netflix on the free Wi-Fi.

Guest access
Guests have exclusive access to the entire condo during the duration of their reservation.

Other things to note
Please know that the property are smoke-free environments. 
Please note that this building does not have an elevator, so you will need to climb stairs to access your unit.
